mobilePolicies.noDuplicateCallbacks: The 10-percent Kuma L-32 Paw-Paw attack is already implemented by the BtL source-script path and is intentionally excluded. Only new owner-index-name-field approved packets are added; active casts are unchanged
mobilePolicies.targetCenter: Damage radii use selected enemy position except explicit casterArea policies; D-03 Binggui has no target field and its source radius 500 is narrowly interpreted as an enemy-centered area
mobilePolicies.line: TR-26 laser uses actor-to-primary direction with source width radius 310, extending beyond the selected enemy by that width; precise Warcraft trajectory is not certified
mobilePolicies.absoluteCooldown: E-07 Fire Fist rolls only while ready and locks for source 4.25 seconds only after a successful proc and live target acquisition; owner removal clears its ledger
mobilePolicies.agility: TR-26 Yata Mirror uses base 350000 per hit and 3500 per point agility only if ConfigureSourceModelHeroAgilityProvider supplies nonnegative actual agility, otherwise zero scaling; primary receives documented 325% of total three-hit base as a separate magical packet
mobilePolicies.kindMultiplier: TR-19 Hinotori physical AoE and magical single-primary bonus share the existing armor and target gates; boss x1.25/story x1.5 apply only to the documented magical component
mobilePolicies.damage: Physical/magic schools, current-health-only-line primary bonus, primary extra amount, nominal basic attack percentage and capped armor break reuse shared HP, armor, and status ledgers
mobilePolicies.limits: Native skill ordering, exact defense/immunity, Queen's omitted source target type and Kizaru precise line geometry remain unverified; the 4.25-second and attribute results are logical offline practice rules, not native engine parity
